# About Google

> About Google provides comprehensive information about Google's products, technology, company history, global operations, and corporate values.

This site serves as the official hub for understanding Google's business model, AI innovations like Gemini, product portfolio, and worldwide presence across nearly 60 countries. It includes localized content in multiple languages reflecting Google's global operations and commitment to transparency.

## Key Topics

- Google
- Gemini
- Google Cloud
- AI
- Google Search
- YouTube
- Gmail
- Google Workspace
- Alphabet
- company-philosophy
- business-model
- ai-research
- data-privacy
- social-impact
- core-values

## Core Company Information

- [About Google: Our products, technology and company information](https://about.google): Google homepage showcasing products, AI capabilities, and company overview
- [About Google: History, office locations, commitments, initiatives](https://about.google/company-info): Company history, locations, sustainability initiatives, and research divisions
- [Google's products and services](https://about.google/products): Comprehensive catalog of Google products including Gemini, Search, and AI tools

## Global Operations & Local Presence

- [Google around the globe](https://about.google/around-the-globe): Google's global presence and international operations across regions
- [Browse a list of Google's office locations](https://about.google/company-info/locations): Directory of Google offices across nearly 60 countries worldwide
- [Google for Korea](https://about.google/intl/ALL_kr/around-the-globe/local-info): Google's role, partnerships, and startup programs in South Korea
- [About Google in the Philippines](https://about.google/intl/ALL_ph/around-the-globe/local-info): Google's operations, AI products, and digital transformation in Philippines
- [About Google in Ukraine](https://about.google/intl/ALL_ua/around-the-globe/local-info): Google's programs, AI training, and initiatives in Ukraine

## Business Model & Philosophy

- [Come Funziona Google: Annunci, Ricavi e Gestione Dati](https://about.google/intl/it_ALL/company-info/how-our-business-works): Italian: Google's business model, advertising revenue, and data management
- [Como o Google funciona](https://about.google/intl/pt_ALL/company-info/how-our-business-works): Portuguese: Google's business operations, advertising, and privacy practices
- [Google が掲げる 10 の事実](https://about.google/intl/ja_ALL/company-info/philosophy): Japanese: Google's 10 core principles and corporate philosophy
- [Diez cosas que sabemos que son ciertas](https://about.google/intl/es_ALL/company-info/philosophy): Spanish: Google's 10 core principles guiding company philosophy
- [Unsere Werte und Engagement](https://about.google/intl/de_ALL/company-info/commitments): German: Google's corporate values, AI principles, and user protection commitments
- [Google の価値観と承諾](https://about.google/intl/zh-TW_ALL/company-info/commitments): Traditional Chinese: Google's values, commitments, and responsible AI principles

## Company History & Story

- [Google の昨日と今日](https://about.google/intl/ko_ALL/company-info/our-story): Korean: Google's founding story by Larry Page and Sergey Brin in 1998
- [Come abbiamo iniziato e dove siamo oggi](https://about.google/intl/it_ALL/company-info/our-story): Italian: Google's founding story and growth from 1998 to present
- [Acerca de Google: historia, oficinas, iniciativas y compromisos](https://about.google/intl/es_ALL/company-info): Spanish: Company history, offices, sustainability, and social impact initiatives

## Support & Contact

- [Google support: Contact information, product help, office locations](https://about.google/company-info/contact-google): Contact methods, support resources, and office locations for various products
